build_behavioral_cloning_trainer: build a BehavioralCloningTrainer with a bc_net model and optimizer for training
configure_optimizers: configure optimizers for the behavioral cloning trainer using the optimizer union
train_step_gen: run a training step that computes cross entropy loss on masked logits
validation_step: run a validation step that computes and returns detached loss on masked logits
check_input: validate that a BehavioralCloningModelInput batch has correct label format and mask alignment
